name: 共有領域の背景と追加指示を記入する自動提案の指針欄
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the workspace-guidance field shown in the supplied reference crop.

Use a clean white background and a wide, compact single-column composition. At the top left, show the heading 「共有領域の指針」 in dark text. Directly below, show the muted supporting sentence 「自動提案に必要な背景や追加の指示を、必要に応じて記入します。」. Beneath that, place one wide white multiline text area with a thin pale-gray outline and softly rounded corners. Inside it, aligned top-left with comfortable padding, show only the muted placeholder 「この共有領域で提案するときの指針…」.

Preserve the source order and proportions: heading, short explanatory sentence, then a nearly full-width text-entry box. Keep a small gap between heading and supporting text, and a larger gap before the box. Match the Japanese mock's margins, textarea height, and rounded border. Use Meiryo with compact readable sizing appropriate to this 648 x 144 component: heading bold, supporting sentence 12/16, body and placeholder regular.

No buttons, icons, additional fields, helper labels, page chrome, shadows, or English text. Fit the complete component into a 4.76:1 canvas, with no blank bands or surrounding whitespace. Render crisp Japanese glyphs and a restrained Linear-like admin style.
reviewNotes: Localized heading, support copy, and textarea placeholder are present. The 2164x727 canvas is 2.98:1 versus the 814x171 source crop at 4.76:1 and 648x144 mock at 4.50:1, leaving broad blank bands above and below. Exact typography and spacing are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
